_note: random_dungeonmagic_level4's interface art, generated with InvokeAI (pipeline/blender_numpy/rdm4_ui_gen.py) and cut out and measured by rdm4_ui_cut.py. Every element is painted on a plain white ground that the cut-out keys away (from the picture's border, and from each 'holes' point: the inside of a hollow frame). 'size' is the generation size (multiples of 16). The element's prompt, its kind's style ('styles'), the common style and the backdrop make the prompt. FLUX.1 Krea dev painted closer to hand-painted art than FLUX.1 dev and cut out cleaner (dev drew a pale drop shadow) in a pilot of both. FLUX has no negative prompt and takes 'no X' as a wish for X: in the first round 'no cross symbol' put a cross on all 16 healing potions, 'no signature' scribbled signatures in the corners, 'no frame, no border' painted torn-paper and vignette backdrops and 'no plate' plates; 'healing' itself invites a cross. Say only what is wanted. An element may have a 'backdrop' of its own: the sweet roll's white icing was cut away with the white ground, so it is painted on teal; the fills (a bar's liquid) have no backdrop at all: with the white one FLUX painted a brush stroke on white. 'slice': the border kept when a piece is stretched (left, top, right, bottom shares; the corner ornaments inside it). The divider is drawn at its own proportions (a stretch smeared its middle gem), and its mirror measure is left out ('thin': a line a few pixels high is a pixel off its mirror). 'enclosed': ground-coloured parts the border cannot reach are cut too (the white between the crossbow's bow, string and stock). A fill's 'crop' drops the dark band FLUX painted above the liquid's surface (measured: to 10-27 % of the height), and the cut evens its brightness along its length. The cut keeps an element's main shape only (loose pieces were painted shadows under floating things), unless it is made of 'pieces' (the spilled nuts). 'icons' says which icon each item of items.json shows: a potion's bottle goes with its tier (the HUD can tint its slot by rarity). The pictures themselves are not committed (they are made again from this file).
style: hand-painted dark fantasy video game art, painterly brush texture, rich but muted colours, crisp clean silhouette with a thin dark outline
